revenue_share: 30% of Net Revenue collected from the end customer for the feature package
exclusivity: Exclusive for light‑duty passenger vehicles in the United States and Canada, non‑exclusive elsewhere
payment_terms: Monthly invoicing for license fees, quarterly invoicing for revenue‑share; payments due within 45 days of invoice date
termination_terms: Either party may terminate for cause with 60‑day cure period; either party may terminate for convenience after 18 months with 180‑day notice; Provider may terminate immediately if OEM undergoes a change of control involving a direct competitor
renewal_terms: Automatically renews for successive 12‑month periods unless either party gives written non‑renewal notice at least 90 days before the term end
